text:
mira: Scheduling dedicated rollout for Veridian next Tue 02:00 PST. Need final signoffs: KV cache warm, KMS rotation not colliding, version pin to v2.14.1, rollback thresholds. @jonathan @emma please.

jonathan: Quick pass on canary metrics — latency +3% at peak but stable. KV cache priming looks OK from last run. One question: are we pinning to stable or RC?

mira: We must pin to stable v2.14.1 (released 03/10). RC has extra swaps we don't want in this customer window.

deploybot: deploybot: deploy request queued for veridian-dedicated slice. runbook: /deploys/veridian/rollout-1758804321. Current head: release/v2.14.1. Canary 5% healthy. To approve run: react with :white_check_mark: or `deploybot approve`.

emma: KMS note: rotation scheduled Wed 04:00 UTC, but Veridian asked to keep key stable during rollout. Confirmed with security; no rotation scheduled for the window. :thumbsup:

lucas: SRE checklist: oncall confirmed. Rollback criteria: 1) tail latency p95 > 300ms for >5m, 2) error rate >1% sustained for 3m, 3) KV miss rate >15% sustained. Rollback target: v2.13.8. Ops will execute immediate rollback if any criterion trips.

sre-ivy: Added pagerduty alert and a dashboard for canary. Bumped canary anomaly sensitivity to 2x for the first 10m.

jonathan: Note: v2.14.1 includes a quantization profile change — infra confirmed kernel fallback present for older devices. We should keep an eye on kernel-compat metrics during canary.

mira: Summary: pin v2.14.1, no KMS rotation, canary 5% for 20m then step. Who will ack deploybot for preflight?

deploybot: deploybot: preflight checks running: kernel-compat ✓, kvcache-prime ✓, autoscaler config ✓, e2e smoke tests running... smoke tests: 2/3 passed, flaky on streaming endpoint. Please advise.

emma: Streaming flake is a known intermittent in the test harness (connection reset). Not blocking for production if canary holds, but please monitor streaming_error_rate metric closely.

lucas: I'm fine to proceed when smoke stabilizes. If the smoke test doesn't pass in 10m, gate the rollout.

mira: I'll give go/no-go in ~12m after smoke completes.

deploybot: deploybot: smoke tests passed (3/3). Canary rollout started: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 30m. Image pinned to sha256:abc123 for v2.14.1. Reporting at each step.

jonathan: :white_check_mark: Watching latency and kernel-compat dashboards.

sre-ivy: Emergency rollback playbook: https://confluence.redwood/rollbacks/veridian-v2.14.1 — added to runbook.

mira: Final approval: mira: :white_check_mark: — proceeding with scheduled window Tue 02:00 PST. Oncall tags applied.

lucas: Oncall ack: lucas: :white_check_mark:

emma: Security ack: emma: :white_check_mark:

deploybot: deploybot: rollout in progress — current 20% traffic. Will post status at 50% or on any incident.

mira: Thanks team. If any alerts trigger, ping @mira and follow the rollback playbook immediately.
